Package com.im.njams.sdk

Class NjamsMetadata

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.NjamsMetadata
  • public class NjamsMetadata
extends Object
    Owns the identifying metadata of an Njams client: path, category, versions, machine and session id. Obtain via njams.metadata().

      • setRuntimeVersion

        public NjamsMetadata setRuntimeVersion​(String runtimeVersion)
        Sets the version of the underlying runtime (eg. Mule, BW6, ...). The runtime version is announced to the nJAMS server in the project message when the client starts.
        Parameters:
        runtimeVersion - the runtime version to set
        Returns:
        this facet, for call chaining
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the client has already been started — a later change would never reach the server
